changeinfo.changes:
• Even more lobby bug fixes and general bug fixes.

For a complete list of updates and fixes, please visit:
www.skullgirls.com

• Minimized the hiccup if a new person joins a lobby while a game is in progress.
  • Fixed a crash after playing for a long time on certain stages.
  • Fixed a bug with lobbies repeatedly matching two of the same players.
  • Fixed a bug where "Threads of Fate" could fail to unlock. If this bug happened to you, completing any Story Mode again should fix it.
  • Many other lobby bug fixes and general bug fixes.
  • More gameplay changes and improvements!

• Added lobbies for multiplayer play and spectating.
  • Added new intro animations for the following characters: Filia, Cerebella, Peacock, Parasoul, Painwheel, Valentine, Big Band and Eliza.
  • Tons of balance and gameplay changes and improvements!
  • A plethora of bug fixes.
